title: Indi-RomCoM：评估LLM在罗马化印度语-英语混合指令上的基准
summary: Indi-RomCoM是一个用于系统评估LLM在罗马化代码混合（RCM）指令上表现的基准，涵盖4种印度语言、7种指令遵循任务和3种混合强度。实验发现LLM在RCM指令上表现不佳，且性能随混合密度增加而下降；推理任务比检测任务退化更少。
summary_en: Indi-RomCoM is a benchmark for evaluating LLMs on Romanized Code-Mixed (RCM) instructions, covering 4 Indic languages, 7 tasks, and 3 mixing levels. LLMs underperform on RCM, with performance degrading as mixing density increases; reasoning tasks degrade less than detection tasks.
